title: Monotonicity of the rank functions for concave compositions
summary: A (strongly) concave composition of an integer $n$ is a sequence of positive integers that is (strictly) decreasing to a point and then (strictly) increasing thereafter, such that the sum of the entries equals $n$. The value at the low point is called the center part. The difference between the number of entries before and after the low point of the sequence is referred to as the rank of the (strongly) concave composition.
